test_description: Verify 'Last-Write-Wins' conflict resolution when syncing offline modifications to Reading Sessions
business_risk: Critical - Data loss or corruption destroys user trust in tracking core value proposition
preconditions: User logged in; Device A offline with local changes; Device B online updated same record; Backend has newer timestamp
test_steps: 1. Device A: Go offline, edit Session X (timestamp T1); 2. Device B: Update Session X (timestamp T2 where T2 > T1); 3. Device A: Go online, trigger sync
expected_result: Backend rejects T1 update; Device A receives T2 state; Local DB updates to match server; Conflict logged
test_data_needs: Pre-seeded user accounts; Mocked network conditions
success_criteria: Data consistency across client/server; No crashes; < 2s sync duration
failure_impact: High - User sees stale data or loses progress
cleanup_requirements: Reset local DB; Wipe test user data
security_considerations: Verify JWT validity during sync retry

test_description: Validate Rate Limiting enforcement for Free Tier users requesting AI recommendations
business_risk: High - Financial loss via OpenAI API abuse; Revenue loss from failed upsell
preconditions: Free Tier User account; 0/5 monthly quota used
test_steps: 1. Authenticate as Free User; 2. Request recommendation 5 times (success); 3. Request 6th recommendation
expected_result: Requests 1-5 return 200 OK; Request 6 returns 429 Too Many Requests; UI shows Upgrade Prompt
test_data_needs: Free User credentials; Premium User credentials (control)
success_criteria: Strict enforcement at 5 requests; Counter resets monthly
security_considerations: Ensure rate limits cannot be bypassed via headers
